title: Broncos CB Riley Moss’s rib injury is reportedly not considered serious

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos CB Riley Moss’s rib injury is reportedly not considered serious
sources.description: We have some good news on the injury front for the Broncos. According to 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis, sources told him that cornerback Riley Moss’s rib injury, which he suffered vs. the Green Bay Packers on Friday night, is NOT considered serious.
